connector.name: SqueezeOS - Institutional AI Market Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Institutional AI market intelligence: squeeze scanner, options flow, council verdicts. x402 RLUSD.
connector.summary: Hosted at squeezeos-api.onrender.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the timwal78 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-Payment-Token
headers.description: JWT payment token for premium tools only. Obtain by: (1) call get_invoice with endpoint_id → (2) pay RLUSD on XRPL or USDC on Base → (3) call verify_payment with tx_hash. Token valid 1 hour. Free tools work without this header.
